steps.name: New Connections (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Harmonia] in "Old Belos", then find [Tia] in the "Amaloon Desert".

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you for agreeing to help, adventurer. Actually, someone else needs help, rather than me.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I heard you visited the Amaloon Desert recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I had some business there...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The wind spirits you purified stayed in the desert for a while. It seems they were near the princess from another world.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: She must have something weighing on her. When the spirits returned, I sensed a great deal of worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tia went through something terrible. Her younger sibling...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You needn't tell me everything. It couldn't be helped.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I wish I could help her, but there's nothing I can do...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: If you have time, please listen to the princess. I ask this as the Spirit King of Harmony and Stability.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I promised Tia I'd help if anything happened. See you later, Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you, adventurer.

steps.name: New Connections (2)
steps.objective: Obtain the <Pyramid Relic> in the "Hall of Rest", then bring it to [Keise] on "Treasure Beach".

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Hello, adventurer. It's good to see you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look unwell. Has something happened?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Nothing in particular. I was thinking of home. I've been looking for a way back, but it's all so uncertain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I need to help Iris find a way soon...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: It's all right. Don't push yourself too hard. There must be a way. Thank you for caring.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Someone else offered to help, too. Do you know a person named Keise?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Keise? The archaeologist at Treasure Beach.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, an archaeologist. She said she's researched archaeology and many other subjects across Freios.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did she come all the way here?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I don't know the details, but she recently came to Lumen to research Eastland.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Her travels brought her here, and we spoke about many things. After hearing my situation, she offered to help.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Keise needs relics from our world to begin the research, but neither of us is strong enough to get them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You need to go inside.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Tia?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm fine. Sorry... I'll continue.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: There's an area in the Hall of Rest with relics that could serve as material. They should help Keise's research.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I know the place. Don't worry. Where is Keise now?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: She said grave robbers were increasing at Treasure Beach and hurried back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll get the relics and take them straight to her. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh, and... Never mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't there something else you wanted to say?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I was going to say something, but I've forgotten. I'll tell you when I remember.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look tired. Leave this to me and rest a little. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you, adventurer. Oh, already gone. Always so eager to get things done...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (After seeing the adventurer off, Tia turns to find a woman in glasses standing before her.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Who are you? How long have you been there?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm sorry if I startled you. I'm Yuran, disciple of Ziskad, leader of the Alliance of Light.

steps.name: New Connections (3)
steps.objective: Obtain the <Pyramid Relic> in the "Hall of Rest", then bring it to [Keise] on "Treasure Beach".

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Oh, adventurer! It's been a while. Thank you again for last time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. The reason I'm here...

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Oh! That's a pyramid relic! Just what I'd expect of you. Very few people have entered that place... Amazing!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can have it. Please tell me when your research is complete.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I'm afraid there's a problem.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Researching Eastland's history, the Amaloon Desert, and the other world, 'Ra,' will take a long time. And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The longer the explanation, the more I suspect you're short on material.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Bingo! Quick as ever. I thought one would suffice, but it doesn't provide enough information.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing to be done, then.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I'm sorry to ask again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How many do you need?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Exactly four. No more, no less. I'm truly sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go. Tell me if you learn anything while I'm away.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Don't worry. Keise always keeps a promise. Hehe.

steps.name: New Connections (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Ocellino] in "Twin Cave" and obtain a <Magic Sea Droplet>, then bring it to [Tia] in the "Amaloon Desert".

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: You carried those heavy things all this way? That's no short journey. Impressive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They were quite heavy. Is this enough?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Of course. It'll be difficult, but I'll put all my knowledge and experience into it. The Alliance of Light has offered support, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Alliance of Light? Who?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: A disciple of Ziskad, its leader. What was her name? The one with glasses, decisive gestures, and a stern expression.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yuran.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's the one who told me to handle everything in the Amaloon Desert... I'm surprised she offered help so readily.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: She was quite kind. Anyway, I'll report my findings to the Alliance of Light.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Still, I feel bad for the princess. I keep thinking how this research will advance my career. Am I just satisfying my own ambitions...?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Adventurer, could I ask you a favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I'd like to give the princess a gift... But it's rather far away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: She grew up in the desert and has never seen the sea. I thought something that holds the sea within it would be nice.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: A good gift, don't you think? It'll shine in response to her magic and become even more beautiful.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Though the princess's beauty would outshine even that.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Ah, Princess Tia. Isn't she lovely?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She is beautiful. Anyway, I'll need to make a trip through Twinkive. I'll get it and take it straight to her.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Yes, yes. Take care on your way. This beach is still dangerous.

steps.name: New Connections (5)
steps.objective: Talk to [Yuran] at the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters".

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: You're back, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It went more smoothly than expected.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: What are you holding?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Keise asked me to bring you a gift.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's full of the sea's energy. She said it would respond to your magic and give you a sense of the ocean.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh... It's beautiful. You've introduced me to kind people, and now brought such a rare gift.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tia, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh, I suddenly thought of my late father. He never saw the sea, either. Nor did my younger sibling...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Keise also suggested going to see the sea together.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I can't wait. The sea... Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank Keise, rather than me. I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm so fortunate to have met so many good people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's because you're a good person yourself, Tia.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you, adventurer. I'll do my best.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: As I said before, I'll fulfill my responsibilities as a member of Ra's royal family to the very end.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh, someone named Yuran came from Lumen while you were away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yuran?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: She came to assess the situation herself and make plans for what comes next. She left quickly, though...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: She mentioned you. She said she had something for you and asked me to tell you to visit Lumen when I saw you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. What could it be...?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Go see her. It might be something good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall I? Then I'll be going, Tia.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Visit whenever you like. I'll be waiting!

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went to see Tia in the Amaloon Desert and heard you'd visited. She said you wanted me to come to Lumen...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Nothing major. I called you because I have something to give you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Resolving the trouble in the Amaloon Desert has strengthened our position against the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I can't go into detail, but at my master's request, we wish to grant you a title that will help in your future endeavors.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Also, I'll arrange a meeting with my master soon. The conversation will likely be important.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Understood.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll tell him you've accepted. I'll inform Lady Iris separately, so please don't worry.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: And this is your bill.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A bill for what? Oh...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Jerky. I trust no explanation is needed?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's good that it's becoming a Lumen specialty. The fact that there's only one consumer is a little concerning.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha. I'll sort it out somehow. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm not worried. In any case, I'll contact you later. We look forward to working with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. Take care. Sigh... My money... How did so much jerky get eaten...?
